examples.sentence: 这套房子交通方便，附近有书店，况且房租又不贵，真是再合适不过了。
examples.romanization: zhè tào fángzi jiāotōng fāngbiàn， fùjìn yǒu shūdiàn， kuàngqiě fángzū yòu bù guì， zhēnshi zài héshì bùguò le。
examples.translation: This apartment has convenient transportation, a bookstore nearby. And besides, the rent is not expensive. It's perfect.

examples.sentence: 那辆汽车大白天被人偷走了。
examples.romanization: nà liàng qìchē dàbáitiān bèi rén tōu zǒu le。
examples.translation: The car was stolen in broad daylight.

title: (与其) V 倒不如 V (rather than V, it’s better to V)
shortExplanation: rather than V, it’s better to V
longExplanation: rather than V, it’s better to V. Pinyin: ( yǔqí) V dǎo bùrú V

examples.sentence: 感冒时应尽量少去公共场所，以免传染别人。
examples.romanization: gǎnmào shí yīng jǐnliàng shǎo qù gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ， yǐmiǎn chuánrǎn biéren。
examples.translation: When you have a cold, you should go to public places as little as possible so as not to infect others.

title: 嫌 (dislike, have a strong negative opinion about)
shortExplanation: dislike, have a strong negative opinion about
longExplanation: dislike, have a strong negative opinion about. Pinyin: xián

examples.sentence: 大家都嫌这个旅行计划不够合理。
examples.romanization: dàjiā dōu xián zhège lǚxíng jìhuà bùgòu hélǐ。
examples.translation: Everyone feels (badly) that travel plan is unreasonable.

title: 动不动就 V (on a whim)
longExplanation: on a whim. Pinyin: dòngbudòng jiù V

examples.sentence: 他最近工作忙、压力大，动不动就着急、发脾气。
examples.romanization: tā zuìjìn gōngzuò máng、 yālì dà， dòngbudòng jiù zháojí、 fāpíqì。
examples.translation: He's been busy and stressed recently. He gets angry on a whim.

title: 甲乙丙丁 (A, B, C, D (series))
longExplanation: A, B, C, D (series). Pinyin: jiǎyǐ bǐng dīng

examples.sentence: 甲、乙、丙、丁是一个序列，相当于英文的A、B、C、D。
examples.romanization: jiǎ、 yǐ、 bǐng、 dīng shì yī gè xùliè， xiāngdāngyú Yīngwén deA、B、C、D。
examples.translation: A, B, C and D are sequences equivalent to A, B, C and D in English.

title: 加以 V (proceed with V)
longExplanation: proceed with V. Pinyin: jiāyǐ V

examples.sentence: 对于你的意见和建议，我们会认真加以研究。
examples.romanization: duìyú nǐ de yìjiàn hé jiànyì， wǒmen huì rènzhēn jiāyǐ yánjiū。
examples.translation: As for your opinions and suggestions, we will carefully (conduct a) study.

title: 大大/远远 V (V by far)
longExplanation: V by far. Pinyin: dàdà/ yuǎnyuǎn V

examples.sentence: 你的能力大大/远远超出了我们的想象。
examples.romanization: nǐ de nénglì dàdà/ yuǎnyuǎn chāochū le wǒmen de xiǎngxiàng。
examples.translation: Your abilities exceeded our imagination by far.

title: 远远 + 不/没 + V/A (far from V-ing, far from A)
shortExplanation: far from V-ing, far from A
longExplanation: far from V-ing, far from A. Pinyin: yuǎnyuǎn + bù/ méi + V/A

examples.sentence: 你现在的知识、能力都远远不能胜任你理想中的工作。
examples.romanization: nǐ xiànzài de zhīshi、 nénglì dōu yuǎnyuǎn bùnéng shèngrèn nǐ lǐxiǎng zhòngdì gōngzuò。
examples.translation: Your current knowledge and abilities are far from [sufficient for you to be] competent for your ideal job.

examples.sentence: 站住！(要是) 不站住，我就开枪了。
examples.romanization: zhànzhù！( yàoshi) bù zhànzhù， wǒ jiù kāiqiāng le。
examples.translation: Stop! If you don't stop, I'll shoot.

examples.sentence: 那一年我出差去天津，特意绕道北京，去了趟圆明园。
examples.romanization: nà yī nián wǒ chūchāi qù Tiānjīn， tèyì ràodào Běijīng， qù le tàng Yuánmíngyuán。
examples.translation: That year, I went to Tianjin on business. On purpose, I made a detour to Beijing and went to Yuanmingyuan.

examples.sentence: 我们已经完成了学业，即将走上工作岗位，开始人生新的一页。
examples.romanization: wǒmen yǐjīng wánchéng le xuéyè， jíjiāng zǒu shàng gōngzuò gǎngwèi， kāishǐ rénshēng xīn de yī yè。
examples.translation: We have finished our studies and about to go to work and start a new page in our lives.

title: 能 + V + 就 + V (V if possible)
longExplanation: V if possible. Pinyin: néng + V + jiù + V

examples.sentence: 这个手机没用多久，能修就修，尽量别换新的。
examples.romanization: zhège shǒujī méiyòng duōjiǔ， néng xiū jiù xiū， jǐnliàng bié huànxīn de。
examples.translation: This mobile phone hasn’t been used for long. If it can be repaired, (then) repair it. Try not to replace it.

examples.sentence: 晚上看书别说蜡烛了，就是灯油也要节省着用。
examples.romanization: wǎnshang kànshū bié shuō làzhú le， jiùshì dēng yóu yě yào jiéshěng zhe yòng。
examples.translation: When [I] read at night, let alone candles, I had to scrooge even on the lamp oil.
